name: u1-klipper-tmc-autotune
title: TMC Autotune for Snapmaker U1
author: Andrew McGregor and contributors; Snapmaker U1 adaptation contributors
description: Packages Klipper TMC Autotune for the Snapmaker U1 vendor Klipper layout. Bespok3d collects the installed X/Y and Z motor constants, renders a printer-specific configuration, preserves the stock sensorless-homing thresholds, and handles placement, restart, rollback, reconfiguration, and removal.
tagline: Motor-aware TMC tuning with U1-safe configuration.

variables.name: U1_XY_RESISTANCE
variables.description: X/Y motor phase resistance in ohms from the exact motor datasheet or measurement.

variables.name: U1_XY_INDUCTANCE
variables.description: X/Y motor phase inductance in henries from the exact motor datasheet or measurement.

variables.name: U1_XY_HOLDING_TORQUE
variables.description: X/Y motor holding torque in newton-metres.

variables.name: U1_XY_MAX_CURRENT
variables.description: X/Y motor rated phase current in amperes.

variables.name: U1_XY_STEPS_PER_REVOLUTION
variables.description: X/Y motor full steps per revolution; normally 200 for a 1.8-degree motor.

variables.name: U1_Z_RESISTANCE
variables.description: Z motor phase resistance in ohms from the exact motor datasheet or measurement.

variables.name: U1_Z_INDUCTANCE
variables.description: Z motor phase inductance in henries from the exact motor datasheet or measurement.

variables.name: U1_Z_HOLDING_TORQUE
variables.description: Z motor holding torque in newton-metres.

variables.name: U1_Z_MAX_CURRENT
variables.description: Z motor rated phase current in amperes.

variables.name: U1_Z_STEPS_PER_REVOLUTION
variables.description: Z motor full steps per revolution; normally 200 for a 1.8-degree motor.

config.label: X/Y resistance (ohms)
config.hint: Use the per-phase value for the exact X/Y motor revision fitted to this U1.

config.label: X/Y inductance (henries)
config.hint: Enter henries, not millihenries: divide a datasheet mH value by 1000.

config.label: X/Y holding torque (Nm)
config.hint: Enter newton-metres, not Ncm or mNm.

config.label: X/Y rated current (A)
config.hint: Use the motor's rated phase current, not Klipper's run_current.

config.label: X/Y full steps per revolution
config.hint: 200 corresponds to 1.8 degrees per full step; 400 corresponds to 0.9 degrees.

config.label: Z resistance (ohms)
config.hint: Use the per-phase value for the exact Z motor revision fitted to this U1.

config.label: Z inductance (henries)
config.hint: Enter henries, not millihenries: divide a datasheet mH value by 1000.

config.label: Z holding torque (Nm)
config.hint: Enter newton-metres, not Ncm or mNm.

config.label: Z rated current (A)
config.hint: Use the motor's rated phase current, not Klipper's run_current.

config.label: Z full steps per revolution
config.hint: 200 corresponds to 1.8 degrees per full step; 400 corresponds to 0.9 degrees.
